description.value: Finley's Bar & Grill is a full-service pub and restaurant in downtown Nelson serving breakfast through late night, with a broad menu spanning eggs benny, wings, burgers, poutine, and banquet-style catering. The venue features a patio and hosts regular live music events, karaoke nights, and community fundraisers, making it a notable gathering spot on Nelson's main strip. Online ordering with delivery and takeout is available alongside full dine-in service.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 49m; bollard (2 spaces) at 75m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at finleys.ca is fully accessible and confirms a real, active bar and grill at 705 Vernon Street, Nelson, matching the OSM address. The site explicitly advertises Dine In, Take Out, and Delivery options, and lists vegetarian-marked items (cauliflower wings marked V, Spinach And Ricotta Stuffed Peppers) and gluten-free beer choices, supporting those amenity values. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Finley's' but the business consistently presents itself as 'Finley's Bar & Grill' across all website pages.
OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-352-5121 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bar and grill confirmed open seven days a week via its own website. Straightforward include.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks Cauliflower Wings as (V); Spinach And Ricotta Stuffed Peppers appears as a standalone entree option; gluten-free beers listed (Pacific Free GF, Whistler Forager GF)

wow_evidence: notable gathering spot on Nelson's main strip
